title: Automate Meeting Notes

what_happened: The user set up a bot to create meeting notes, connected it to Google Calendar and Google Docs, and configured it to produce a summary, decisions, open questions, action items with owners and due dates, and a follow-up draft saved as a Google Doc. The user can trigger the bot after a meeting to create the notes, and requires approval before sending any message or sharing notes. This is a public pattern for automating meeting notes.
